text: Then he cried{H7121} in mine ears{H241} with a loud{H1419} voice,{H6963} saying,{H559} Cause ye them that have charge{H6486} over the city{H5892} to draw near,{H7126} every man{H376} with his destroying{H4892} weapon{H3627} in his hand.{H3027}
